purpose: Determine and record which commit's CODE actually generated the twelve physical trajectories, distinct from which commit HAPPENED TO BE HEAD at each stage's launch moment -- per evidence-hardening review Section 4. Determined retrospectively from git history and file-content hashes, since the stage_manifest.json files written at run time do not record a git_head field (a gap noted below, to fix prospectively in any future campaign).

protocol_freeze_commit.note: Section A freeze files only; no trajectory code exists yet at this commit

producer_code_commit.note: introduces scripts/run_developed_confirmation_stage.py and arrhenius_fracture/crack_rebonding_developed_confirmation_v10230.py -- the code that actually runs a trajectory and evaluates the developed/stationarity gate. Confirmed via git diff that NEITHER file was modified again between this commit and abe82a6 (the v1 final-evidence commit) -- see producer_file_sha256_at_producer_commit below, independently re-verified by the verifier at every run.

stage_1_repo_head_at_launch.note: Stage 1 (seed=1720) was launched with repo HEAD literally at this commit -- identical to producer_code_commit, so HEAD-at-launch and producer-code-commit coincide for Stage 1.

stage_1_result_commit.note: commits Stage 1's tracked ledger/decision/verification artifacts and job-registry update AFTER the six Stage-1 trajectories finished running; does not touch producer code

stage_2_repo_head_at_launch.note: Stage 2 (seed=1001723) was launched with repo HEAD at ac0337f, NOT at producer_code_commit (aa6982a) -- but ac0337f only added data/artifact files (ledger, decision, verification, job registry) and never touched scripts/run_developed_confirmation_stage.py or arrhenius_fracture/crack_rebonding_developed_confirmation_v10230.py, so the ACTUAL PHYSICAL PRODUCER CODE Stage 2 executed is byte-identical to Stage 1's (both trace to producer_code_commit aa6982a). This is the case the review specifically asked to distinguish: HEAD-at-launch differs, physical-producer-code does not.

plot_producer_commit.note: scripts/plot_developed_confirmation.py; committed while Stage 2 was still running as a background physics process -- irrelevant to Stage 2's already-launched subprocess, which had already imported its own code from disk at launch time

v1_final_evidence_commit.note: Stage 2 results, final figures, and the v1 terminal classification (DEVELOPED_REBONDING_STEEPENING_CONFIRMED) -- accepted by reviewer with required evidence-hardening follow-up

evidence_hardening_branch_base.note: codex/v10.2.30-crack-rebonding-developed-evidence-hardening branches from here; analysis-only, no new trajectories

producer_file_sha256_at_producer_commit.note: these are the file contents AS OF producer_code_commit (aa6982a). The verifier re-hashes scripts/run_developed_confirmation_stage.py and arrhenius_fracture/crack_rebonding_developed_confirmation_v10230.py against these values at every run (the two files that actually drive trajectory generation and gate evaluation); analyze_developed_confirmation.py and build_developed_confirmation_event_ledger.py hashes are recorded for completeness but were subsequently modified in THIS branch (evidence-hardening pass) -- their v1 hashes here are historical record of what produced the v1 decision, not what the verifier re-checks now (the verifier's independent_recompute path supersedes analyze_developed_confirmation.py's v1 logic entirely).

verification_method.how_determined: git log -- <path> to find each producer file's last-modifying commit before the commit in question; git diff <producer_code_commit> <later_commit> -- <producer files> to confirm zero diff (empty output) through every intervening commit up to and including v1_final_evidence_commit
verification_method.gap_noted_for_future_campaigns: stage_manifest.json (written by run_developed_confirmation_stage.py at run time) does not record git_head or a producer-file-hash snapshot. This provenance record had to be reconstructed retrospectively from git history instead of read directly from a run-time artifact. A future campaign's runner script should record sys.argv[0]'s enclosing repo's git rev-parse HEAD and sha256 of its own source file into stage_manifest.json at launch time, so this reconstruction step is unnecessary.
